title: Probing Conformational Dynamics of Antibodies with Geometric Simulations.
authors: Tucs, Andrejs; Tsuda, Koji; Sljoka, Adnan
one_liner_zh: 该文用几何模拟FRODAN预测抗体构象动态，虽对象为折叠蛋白抗体而非IDP，但方法可迁移至无序蛋白/复合物的长时程构象采样，且涉及域间与CDR环运动，对互作机制建模有启发。
abstract: This chapter describes the application of constrained geometric simulations for prediction of antibody structural dynamics. We utilize constrained geometric simulations method FRODAN, which is a low computational complexity alternative to molecular dynamics (MD) simulations that can rapidly explore flexible motions in protein structures. FRODAN is highly suited for conformational dynamics analysis of large proteins, complexes, intrinsically disordered proteins, and dynamics that occurs on longer biologically relevant time scales that are normally inaccessible to classical MD simulations. This approach predicts protein dynamics at an all-atom scale while retaining realistic covalent bonding, maintaining dihedral angles in energetically good conformations while avoiding steric clashes in addition to performing other geometric and stereochemical criteria checks. In this chapter, we apply FRODAN to showcase its applicability for probing functionally relevant dynamics of IgG2a, including large-amplitude domain-domain motions and motions of complementarity determining region (CDR) loops. As was suggested in previous experimental studies, our simulations show that antibodies can explore a large range of conformational space.
abstract_zh: 本章描述了约束几何模拟在预测抗体结构动力学中的应用。我们采用约束几何模拟方法FRODAN，这是一种计算复杂度较低的替代分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟的方法，能够快速探索蛋白质结构中的柔性运动。FRODAN非常适合大型蛋白质、复合物、 intrinsically disordered proteins（固有无序蛋白质）的构象动力学分析，以及发生在较长生物学相关时间尺度上的动力学过程，这些通常难以通过经典MD模拟触及。该方法在全原子尺度上预测蛋白质动力学，同时保留真实的共价键合，维持二面角处于能量有利的构象，避免空间位阻冲突，并执行其他几何和立体化学标准检查。在本章中，我们应用FRODAN展示其在探测IgG2a功能相关动力学方面的适用性，包括大振幅的域间运动和互补决定区 (complementarity determining region, CDR) 环的运动。正如先前实验研究所提示的，我们的模拟表明抗体能够探索广泛的构象空间。
